moduleTitle: The environment and where people live

note.title: The environment and where people live
note.specFocus: Home and town, urban and rural life, buildings and facilities, weather, pollution, climate change, recycling, transport, and individual and collective action.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
The environment and where people live

Key vocabulary
- el barrio; las afueras; la vivienda; el ayuntamiento; la contaminación; el calentamiento global; reciclar; ahorrar; el contenedor; tirar; el transporte público; la sequía; sostenible

Key grammar
- Use vivir in location, hay to say what exists, estar for location, and comparatives for towns. Use se puede/se debe for environmental advice and si clauses for possible solutions.

Exam tips
- Link each problem to a practical solution. Remember ser for climate descriptions and hacer weather expressions, and use más/menos before adjectives.

questions.examTip: Translate sense units, not isolated words, and check tense and negatives before finalising each answer.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I live on the outskirts, near a park and the station.
2. We recycle glass, cardboard and plastic every week.
3. The council will build cycle lanes next year.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the passage and answer in English.

“Vivo en las afueras, cerca de un parque y de la estación. Reciclamos vidrio, cartón y plástico todas las semanas. El ayuntamiento construirá carriles para bicicletas el próximo año.”

1. What is said in the first sentence?
2. What additional point appears in the second sentence?
3. Give the main idea of the final sentence.

questions.examTip: Translate sense units, not isolated words, and check tense and negatives before finalising each answer.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. My neighbourhood has a new sports centre, but there is no cinema.
2. Air pollution gets worse when there are too many cars.
3. Last week my neighbours cleaned the river in the park.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the passage and answer in English.

“Mi barrio tiene un polideportivo nuevo, pero no hay cine. La contaminación del aire empeora cuando hay demasiados coches. La semana pasada mis vecinos limpiaron el río del parque.”

1. What is said in the first sentence?
2. What additional point appears in the second sentence?
3. Give the main idea of the final sentence.

questions.modelAnswer:

2. I go to school by bus to reduce emissions.
3. I switch off lights and turn off the tap to save energy and water.

“Preferiría vivir en una casa con jardín en el campo. Voy al instituto en autobús para reducir las emisiones. Apago las luces y cierro el grifo para ahorrar energía y agua.”

1. What is said in the first sentence?
2. What additional point appears in the second sentence?
3. Give the main idea of the final sentence.
